# Windows-only test deselections for CI (SPEC.md 6.2, ROADMAP theme T2).
#
# One line per pytest node ID; # comments allowed. Every entry must have a
# GitHub issue tracking the underlying Windows defect — the entry is removed
# when the fix lands. Never add anything here that is not a hard process
# crash (access violation / segfault): ordinary failures fix forward.

tests/test_text.py::test_a_read_only_input_refuses_every_keyboard_edit

# Same family as the entry above (#5): synthetic events against a
# read-only text input, access violation. Crashed on the [box] param
# (run 34918702144); the other params die behind it, so the whole test
# (all params) is deselected until #5's root cause is fixed.
tests/test_text.py::test_a_read_only_input_still_selects_and_copies

# Third member of the #5 family (run 34920742365): read-only input +
# synthetic user select/copy events, access violation in the test body
# (line 208). The pattern is now precise: read-only widget + synthetic
# event delivery crashes; read-only WITHOUT events passes (cursor,
# traversal), editable WITH events passes.
tests/test_text.py::test_a_read_only_input_lets_the_user_select_and_copy

# Fourth crash (run 34921166789) rewrites the diagnosis: died AT the
# `tk.call("clipboard", "clear")` line (test_text.py:280), before any
# synthetic events — so clipboard operations alone can fault, yet
# test_combobox.py's copy_selection passed earlier in the same run. The
# trigger is narrower than either first hypothesis; see #5. Confirmed
# crash:
tests/test_text.py::test_copy_selection_leaves_the_clipboard_alone_when_empty
# Predicted family (every remaining test_text.py test that reads/writes the
